description: This file defines a React functional component called RoleSwitcher, which manages user role state ('doctor' or 'pharmacist'). It loads the initial role from storage, updates it on user interaction, and calls optional callback on changes. The component renders a toggle UI with styled buttons to switch roles.

methods.name: RoleSwitcher
methods.description: React functional component that renders a role toggle switch, manages role state, loads initial role from storage, and saves updates to storage. Calls optional onChange callback when role changes.
